scientific_integrity: The main theorem is supported by explicit case classification and exact enumerative proof, with independent dynamic-programming cross-checks only as finite corroboration. No priority claim is made for generic palindromic-factorization methods or the two-piece characterization.
scientific_limitations: The full classification is for binary words with exactly five positive run lengths. Its distribution concerns uniform positive compositions, not unrestricted random binary words. Numerical checks are finite; the general proof uses transition accounting, finite decomposition cases, and rational generating functions. Equivalent literature specializations remain possible.
title: Multiplicity and limit law of minimum palindromic factorizations in five-run binary words
